_doc: Phase 042b: the single source of truth for what the clean tree receives. build_clean_tree.py reads this file. Each 'copy' entry copies a file from its working-tree path (repo-relative, 'from' = 'path') over the HEAD archive; 'status' is 'replace' (the HEAD file exists) or 'new'. Each 'anchored' entry replaces one exact text block ('old', asserted to occur once in the HEAD file) with 'new'. Shared files that other sessions edit are changed only by 'anchored' entries, and their working-tree copy is not written by this phase.
